name: What types of glass are available for patio door replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of glass are available for patio door replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When replacing patio door glass, common options include tempered glass for safety and standard annealed glass. You can also choose from various energy-efficient options like double-pane or low-emissivity (Low-E) glass, which help improve insulation and reduce energy costs by reflecting heat. Consider your local climate in Alameda or surrounding areas; areas with more direct sunlight might benefit significantly from Low-E coatings to prevent heat gain.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include tempered, annealed, double-pane, and Low-E glass, each offering different safety and energy efficiency benefits.
